evidence_quotes.O: 23 years ago I built a boom box using the first ever Sony D-5 CD player as the anchor.
evidence_quotes.C: after reviewing as many Amazon reviews as I could before the purchase, I was confident this model would do the job.
evidence_quotes.E: When I returned them later that day, the clerk asked,"Is there anything wrong with them?" I said, "Yeah, they suck".
evidence_quotes.A: To anyone who may like these, I am sorry to learn about your hearing disability.
evidence_quotes.N: There is really nothing bad I can think of to say about the Sennheiser MM 550-X Bluetooth headphones.
